interface.title: Field specific lacuna identifier (Lacuna v0.7.0, Streamlit web UI)
interface.field: Research methods / literature review across any discipline (example spec: education research on generative AI and critical thinking; thesis example: online clustering)
interface.stage_of_work: Early research scoping: finding and screening literature, spotting reported gaps, and handing a brief to an AI assistant
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn a structured research specification into a bounded, TF-IDF proximity-ranked set of records with inspectable evidence excerpts, pull author-reported limitations and future-work statements out of theses, and export one assistant-ready Markdown brief (plus optional ZIP/JSON packages).

data.note: Used 'Load example specification' (built-in) for the spec, then uploaded synthetic_records.json (3 records) for discovery and synthetic_theses.json (2 theses) for Field gaps. All external sources (OpenAlex/Crossref) were cleared or bypassed with offline mode, because the sandbox has no network. All records are labelled 'SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY'. The retrieval and ranking phase was therefore only tested offline with 3 synthetic records; online sources, seed-DOI/citation expansion, local PDF full-text evidence and the topic taxonomy were not exercised (see not_done).

tree.general: Scope a research topic: find and rank the related literature, surface reported open problems, and package the findings for later analysis
tree.specific: Build a Lacuna research specification, run bounded discovery over local records, inspect proximity-ranked studies and evidence, extract thesis-reported field gaps, try topic branches, and export the assistant brief/ZIP

features.name: Structured specification form with JSON twin and schema validation
features.general: Describe a study question as structured fields (title, synonym groups, population, methods, years, types), see the same thing as JSON, edit or upload the JSON directly, and validate it against a shared schema with field-level error messages
features.specific: Specification tab: Form/JSON radio, concept_groups with '|' synonyms per line, Build request JSON, Validate specification (e.g. 'profile.concept_groups: List should have at least 1 item'), Save request JSON, template.json / schema.json / input.prompt downloads
steps: Load example or fill form fields
Switch to JSON mode and edit/paste/upload
serves_tasks: Fill in the specification from a worked example and preview the machine-readable request it produces
Write or paste a specification as structured text (e.g. one drafted elsewhere) and validate it against the schema

features.name: Bounded-retrieval limits panel with source picker
features.general: Choose which data sources a search may query (or none, for local-only) and cap how much it may fetch: per-source records, queries, request budget, downloads, pages, evidence per item
features.specific: config.sources multiselect (openalex, crossref, core, oai; empty = local input only) and config / retrieval, evidence, and export limits expander (per_source, max_queries, request_budget, citation_rounds, evidence_per_study, package_studies, compact_studies, oai_url, use_cache)
steps: Open sources dropdown and add/remove sources
Expand limits and step numeric caps
Run and check the caps in coverage.json
serves_tasks: Choose which sources to search and cap retrieval limits

features.name: Filterable ranked-results table linked to a per-item evidence inspector
features.general: Rank items by a similarity score, filter by text and minimum score, then pick one item to see its score breakdown and the exact text excerpts that matched each search term
features.specific: Results tab: dataframe (score, title, year, groups x/y, evidence, type, doi) + filter.title_or_doi + filter.min_score; study.id selectbox follows the filter and shows a JSON score breakdown (word_score, character_score, concept/mechanism/dimension matches) and evidence[n] / title|abstract expanders with matched_terms
steps: Set min score and/or title substring
Expand score JSON and evidence excerpts
serves_tasks: Review ranked records and narrow the list
Inspect why a record ranked where it did
Re-run with a different specification and compare rankings

features.name: Search coverage / provenance log
features.general: Show exactly which queries were generated from the synonym groups, how many records came from each source, deduplication, missing-data counts and stated limits, so the search is auditable
features.specific: coverage.json / request log expander (queries with boolean/plain/label/family, query_families, raw_records_by_source, unique_records, with_abstract, full_text_status, scoring weights, limits), with copy-to-clipboard
serves_tasks: Check what queries were run and how complete the search was

features.name: Author-reported gap extractor with per-gap source evidence
features.general: From a set of documents, pull out sentences where authors state limitations, future work or open questions about a topic, list them by category, and for each show the source excerpt and a suggested query to check whether it is still open
features.specific: Field gaps tab: Research field / topic + optional keyword groups + thesis sources / Offline-local-only + thesis PDF/record uploads + gap limits → Find field gaps → table (id, category, statement, sources) + gap.id selectbox → source thesis excerpt (study_id, section, type_basis), follow-up status, verification boolean query, Gap analysis coverage; export Field gaps .json / report .md
steps: Choose offline mode and upload thesis records
Pick a gap.id to see its source excerpt and suggested query
serves_tasks: Extract author-reported gaps for a topic from local theses
Read each reported gap with its source and a suggested check query
Export the gap list as a report
Re-run gap extraction with explicit keyword groups

features.name: Single-file assistant brief exporter with detail level
features.general: Bundle the question, search coverage, selected evidence and interpretation instructions into one Markdown file at a chosen detail level, with size readout, preview, browser download or save to a server folder, plus optional full/compact archives and raw JSON (in the runs recorded, Concise and Extended gave the same size, so the detail-level difference is not yet shown)
features.specific: Artifacts tab: Evidence detail (Concise brief / Extended brief) with character/KB count, Download assistant brief .md, Save folder + Save to folder (auto-suffixes _1), Preview / copy the complete assistant brief, Optional technical exports (Full package .zip, Compact package .zip, Result .json)
serves_tasks: Preview and export one self-contained summary document at a chosen level of detail

features.name: Local run history

features.specific: Runs tab: Local run store run.id selectbox (discovery, field-gap and topic-branch runs) + Load run; Results/Artifacts then show the loaded run
